one_liner: Plays an MP4 video on a specified mesh, with configurable aspect ratio, fit mode, and looping.
primary_use_case: Embedding video textures onto 3D objects in a Hyperfy world, e.g., screens or curved surfaces.
preview_recommendation: Use the provided UVscroll.mp4 preview to verify video playback on a mesh named 'Screen'; ensure the mesh geometry matches the aspect ratio settings.
manifest_quality_notes: Fallback video preview from any author
Model and script sizes are minimal
